problem:
Which of the following random variables could be modeled as a binomial distribution?

I. The number of blue tickets among the $5$ winning tickets in a raffle, if $25%$ of the sold tickets are blue. Assume that a very large number of tickets have been sold, so that extracting a blue ticket does not affect the probability of getting a blue ticket on the next extraction

II. The number of departures from an airport during a day

III. The number of women in the sample of $150$ women with a gene associated with breast cancer
